title: Is Taichung in drought?
shows: SPI and SPEI on a 130-year CWA rain gauge with ERA5 temperature.
problem: Is Taichung in drought now, and how does this dry spell compare with the worst on record? It matters for the city's water supply.
stop_reason: gate failed: min_years (10 years of record, 30 needed: too short); the fallback drought_indices did not pass its own gates
headline: Using taiwan_cwa station 467490 (Taichung), the nearest available station in this catalog, current SPI-3 is 0.87 and SPEI-3 is 0.77 as of 2026-06-01, both classed normal; Taichung is not in drought by this reading.
